atoms.text: Long before settlers from Europe came to America, people were living there. They are called “indigenous peoples”. </br>Today, there are more than 500 indigenous tribes in the USA.

atoms.a: Die Sioux-Stämme waren eine Gruppe von Stämmen, die Nomaden waren. Sie jagten Bisonherden, weil deren Fleisch ihr Hauptnahrungsmittel war.
atoms.b: The Sioux were a group of ((++tribes sites)) who were nomads. They ((++hunted hid_from)) bison herds because their meat was their main source of food.

atoms.a: Sie nutzten aber auch die Haut und das Fell der Bisons, um daraus Decken und Kleidung herzustellen.
atoms.b: They also used the bison's skin and ((++fur teeth)) to make ((++blankets flowers)) and clothes.

atoms.a: Aus den Knochen stellten die Sioux Waffen her, zum Beispiel Pfeile. Die Haare der Bisons nutzten sie zum Nähen.
atoms.b: The Sioux made ((++weapons buckets)) out of bones: ((++arrows handbags)) for example. They used the bison's hair for sewing.

atoms.a: Weil die Sioux Nomaden waren, reisten sie viel. Sie bewegten sich hauptsächlich im nördlichen Teil der USA.
atoms.b: Because the Sioux were ((++nomads bakers)), they travelled a lot. They mainly travelled through the ((++northern eastern)) part of the USA.

atoms.a: Sie lebten in Tipis, da diese einfach auf- und abzubauen sind.
atoms.b: They lived in ((++tepees flats)) because they are easy to build and take down.

atoms.text:
The Cherokee tribe is the biggest tribe in the USA.
Centuries ago, the Cherokee lived in the south-eastern part of the USA. They lived in homes with thatched roofs that were made of mud and grass.
The Cherokee believe in spirits and perform ceremonies to ask the spirits for help. The biggest ceremony is the “Green Corn Ceremony” were they thank the spirits for the corn harvest.

atoms.a: Die Apachen-Stämme lebten in den südlichen Regionen der USA.
atoms.b: The Apache ((++tribes)) lived in the southern part of the USA.

atoms.a: Sie reisten nicht viel umher, aber wie die Sioux jagten die Apachen Bisons.
atoms.b: They didn't travel that much, but like the Sioux, the Apache ((++hunted)) bison.

atoms.a: Sie lebten in Wigwams und in Tipis. Ein Wigwam sieht wie eine runde Hütte aus. Es kann wie ein Tipi abgebaut werden, aber es benötigt etwas mehr Zeit.
atoms.b: They lived in wigwams as well as in ((++tepees)). A wigwam looks like a round shack. It can be taken down like a tepee, but it needs more ((++time)) to do so.

atoms.a: Zum Jagen nutzten die Apachen auch Bögen und Pfeile.
atoms.b: For hunting, the Apache also used bows and ((++arrows)).

atoms.a: Ihre Kleidung wurde aus Leder hergestellt. Die Apachen dekorierten sie aber auch mit Federn. Sie trugen auch Schuhe aus weichem Leder. Sie heißen “Mokassins”.
atoms.b: Their ((++clothes)) were made out of leather. The Apache also decorated them with feathers. They also wore ((++shoes)) made out of soft leather. They're called “Moccasins”.
